message.content:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: wordsmith
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db-init
  namespace: wordsmith
data:
  init.sql: |
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS words (
      id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
      word VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL
    );
    INSERT INTO words (word) VALUES ('hello'), ('world'), ('docker'), ('kubernetes');
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db-secret
  namespace: wordsmith
type: Opaque
stringData:
  POSTGRES_USER: wordsmith
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: wordsmith
  POSTGRES_DB: wordsmith
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  selector:
    app: wordsmith-db
  ports:
    - name: postgres
      port: 5432
      targetPort: 5432
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: wordsmith-db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: wordsmith-db
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: postgres:10.0-alpine
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5432
          env:
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
            - name: POSTGRES_DB
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_DB
          volumeMounts:
            - name: db-init
              mountPath: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: "128Mi"
              cpu: "100m"
            limits:
              memory: "256Mi"
              cpu: "500m"
      volumes:
        - name: db-init
          configMap:
            name: wordsmith-db-init
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-api
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  selector:
    app: wordsmith-api
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 8080
      targetPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-api
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: wordsmith-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: wordsmith-api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: dockersamples/wordsmith-api:latest
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          env:
            - name: DB_HOST
              value: wordsmith-db
            - name: DB_PORT
              value: "5432"
            - name: DB_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
            - name: DB_NAME
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_DB
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: "16Mi"
              cpu: "50m"
            limits:
              memory: "32Mi"
              cpu: "200m"
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-web
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  selector:
    app: wordsmith-web
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: 80
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-web
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: wordsmith-web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: wordsmith-web
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: dockersamples/wordsmith-web:latest
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
          env:
            - name: API_HOST
              value: wordsmith-api
            - name: API_PORT
              value: "8080"
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: "32Mi"
              cpu: "50m"
            limits:
              memory: "64Mi"
              cpu: "200m"
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 80
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 80
            initialDelaySeconds: 3
            periodSeconds: 5
```
